scripts.text:
delete from temp_PurchaseOrders;

insert into temp_PurchaseOrders
(
	Site
    ,PONumber
    ,POLine
    ,PORelease
    ,PODate
    ,VendorNumber
    --,VendorID
    ,InvoiceNumber
    ,InvoiceDate
    ,CurrencyCode
    ,ExchRate
    ,POStatus
    ,POType
    ,BlanketQty
    ,Item
    --,ItemID
    ,ItemCost
    ,OrderedQty
    ,ReceivedQty
    ,RejectedQty
    ,ReturnedQty
    ,ReleaseDate
    ,PromiseDate
    ,ReceivedDate
    ,DueDate
    ,RecordDate
    ,CreateDate
    ,UM
    ,WHSE
    ,LineStatus
)
select 
	h.site_ref, h.po_num, r.po_line, r.po_release, h.order_date, h.vend_num, h.inv_num, h.inv_date, h.curr_code, h.exch_rate, h.stat, h.type, r.qty_ordered as blanket_qty,
	 r.item, r.item_cost, r.qty_ordered, r.qty_received, r.qty_rejected, r.qty_returned,
	h.order_date release_date,r.promise_date, r.rcvd_date, r.due_date, r.RecordDate, r.CreateDate,
	r.u_m, r.whse, r.stat --, r.DLDeleteIndicator
from stg.csi_po_header h 
  inner join stg.csi_po_release r on 
	h.site_ref = r.site_ref and
	h.po_num = r.po_num
where h.type = 'R';
